The vendor directly providing the software platform at **twilio.com** is **Twilio Inc.** (contracting through regional affiliates such as **Twilio Ireland Limited** for users in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland).

### Evidence
* According to the **Twilio Terms of Service** (`twilio.com/legal/tos`), the contracting entity entering into the agreement for customers outside Europe is:
  > *"Twilio Inc., a Delaware corporation, with a place of business at 101 Spear Street, 5th Floor, San Francisco, California, 94105, United States of America"* (and *"Twilio Ireland Limited, a company registered in the Republic of Ireland"* for customers in the EEA, UK, Switzerland, etc.).
* Twilio's **Website Privacy Notice** (`twilio.com/legal/privacy`) and site footer similarly identify the operating entity:
  > *"mandating how Twilio Inc. and its group companies (“Twilio”, “we”, or “our”) process personal data wherever we operate"* and *"Copyright © Twilio Inc. All rights reserved."*
